The '''Vendusii sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in<ref name="Mid Rim" /> the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] region<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Vendusii sector bordered the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], and the [[Herdessa sector/Legends|Herdessa]] and [[Daimar sector/Legends|Daimar sectors]] [[spinward]], while sharing the [[trailing]] border with the [[Far Xandil sector/Legends|Far Xandil]] and [[Ryndellian sector/Legends|Ryndellian sectors]]. Together with the Daimar and Ryndellian sectors, the Vendusii sector formed the Mid Rim's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] border, neighboring the [[Cadavine sector/Legends|Cadavine]], [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini]], and [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sectors]] of the Outer Rim.<ref name="Mid Rim" />

The Vendusii sector contained the [[Haluria system/Legends|Haluria system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> home to the creatures known as [[Halurian ice-boar]]s,<ref name="PoD" /><ref name="Planetnamia-Haluria" /> as well as the [[Vendusii system/Legends|Vendusii system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> the origin point of the [[Vendusii Crystal]] [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]].<ref name="Heroes & Rogues">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia-Vendusii">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Vendusii Crystal]]|system=[[Vendusii system/Legends|Vendusii system]]|legends=1}}</ref> The [[Llanic Spice Run/Legends|Llanic Spice Run]]<ref name="Llanic Spice Run" /> [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] passed through the sector close to its border with the Daimar sector.<ref name="Mid Rim" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vendusii sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> The sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the [[2012]] StarWars.com article [https://web.archive.org/web/20170713024921/http://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim The Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim], which placed it in grid squares P-16, P-17, and Q-17.<ref name="Mid Rim" />
